title: IaCM Deep Dive: Infrastructure Intelligence 360
subtitle: Everything Infrastructure-as-Code Management in one place: workspaces, resources, providers, modules, IaC executions (init/plan/apply/destroy/drift), Git sources, tags, policy-as-code and cross-view correlations.

widget.text:
**What's inside:** an executive KPI strip, then 8 tabs that go from inventory (workspaces, resources, modules, repositories, tags) to operations (every IaCM pipeline stage and OpenTofu/Terraform plugin step) to governance (OPA evaluations on IaCM runs) and finally cross-view correlations.  
**Time window:** executions and policy evaluations use their start/evaluation time. Workspace inventory counts workspaces *alive in the window* (created before the window end and last updated after its start); stale workspaces are those not updated during the window. Resources use their last-seen sync time.  
**Filters:** Organization / Project apply everywhere; Workspace, Provisioner, Status and Repository apply to inventory widgets; Provider applies to resource widgets. Workspace names link to the IaCM workspace page.

widget.title: Workspaces (as of window end)
widget.subtitle: All workspaces created on or before the window end

widget.title: New Workspaces

queries.query:
find view "iacm:fct_workspace_events" w | filter w.created >= cast(${start_time} as timestamp) and w.created <= cast(${end_time} as timestamp) | filter ${org_filter_predicate} and ${project_filter_predicate} and ${workspace_filter_predicate} and ${provisioner_filter_predicate} and ${status_filter_predicate} and ${repository_filter_predicate}
| select { distinct_count(w.unique_id) as new_workspaces }

widget.title: IaC Command Mix

queries.query:
find view "view:pipeline:step_execution" st | filter st.step_type in ["IACMOpenTofuPlugin","IACMTerraformPlugin"] and st.start_ts >= cast(${start_time} as timestamp) and st.start_ts <= cast(${end_time} as timestamp) | filter ${org_filter_predicate} and ${project_filter_predicate} | select { case when lower(st.step_identifier) in ["detectdrift","detect_drift"] then "Drift" when lower(st.step_identifier) in ["plandestroy","plan_destroy","tofu_destroy_plan"] then "Plan Destroy" when lower(st.step_identifier) in ["destroy","tofu_destroy","opentofu_destroy"] then "Destroy" when lower(st.step_identifier) in ["apply","tofu_apply","opentofu_apply"] then "Apply" when lower(st.step_identifier) in ["plan","tofu_plan","opentofu_plan","plan_refresh"] then "Plan" when lower(st.step_identifier) in ["init","opentofu_init","initialize"] then "Init" else "Other" end as command, count() as steps }
| group_by command | order_by steps desc

widget.title: Workspace Growth: New per Week vs Cumulative

queries.query:
with wk as (find view "iacm:fct_workspace_events" w | filter w.created <= cast(${end_time} as timestamp) | filter ${org_filter_predicate} and ${project_filter_predicate} and ${workspace_filter_predicate} and ${provisioner_filter_predicate} and ${status_filter_predicate} and ${repository_filter_predicate}
| select { date_trunc("week", w.created) as week, distinct_count(w.unique_id) as new_workspaces } | group_by week),
cum as (find wk | select { week, new_workspaces, sum(new_workspaces) over (order by week) as total_workspaces })
find cum | filter week >= cast(${start_time} as timestamp) | order_by week asc

widget.subtitle: Bars: new workspaces (left); right axis: running total since first workspace

widget.title: Project 360 Scorecard

queries.query:
with ws as (find view "iacm:fct_workspace_events" w | filter w.updated >= cast(${start_time} as timestamp) and w.created <= cast(${end_time} as timestamp) | filter ${org_filter_predicate} and ${project_filter_predicate} and ${workspace_filter_predicate} and ${provisioner_filter_predicate} and ${status_filter_predicate} and ${repository_filter_predicate}
| select { w.org as org, w.project as project, distinct_count(w.unique_id) as workspaces,
distinct_count(case when w.status in ["drifted","apply_needed","failed","unknown"] then w.unique_id end) as needs_attention }
| group_by w.org, w.project),
res as (find entity "iacm:resource" r | filter r.last_seen_millis_ts >= cast(${start_time} as timestamp) and r.last_seen_millis_ts <= cast(${end_time} as timestamp)
| select { r.org as org, r.project as project, count() as resources } | group_by r.org, r.project),
ex as (find view "view:pipeline:stage_execution" se | filter se.stage_type = "IACM" and se.is_deleted = false and se.start_ts >= cast(${start_time} as timestamp) and se.start_ts <= cast(${end_time} as timestamp)
| select { se.org_identifier as org, se.project_identifier as project,
distinct_count(se.plan_execution_id) as executions,
round(100.0 * count(case when se.status = "SUCCESS" then 1 end) / count(), 1) as success_rate,
count(case when se.status = "FAILED" then 1 end) as failed_stages }
| group_by se.org_identifier, se.project_identifier)
find ws | left join res on res.org = ws.org and res.project = ws.project
| left join ex on ex.org = ws.org and ex.project = ws.project
| select { ws.org as org, ws.project as project, ws.workspaces as workspaces, ws.needs_attention as needs_attention,
coalesce(res.resources, 0) as resources, coalesce(ex.executions, 0) as executions,
coalesce(ex.success_rate, 0) as success_rate, coalesce(ex.failed_stages, 0) as failed_stages }
| order_by workspaces desc | limit 50

queries.query:
find view "iacm:fct_workspace_events" w | join entity "iacm:workspace" e on e.unique_id = w.unique_id | filter w.updated >= cast(${start_time} as timestamp) and w.created <= cast(${end_time} as timestamp) | filter ${org_filter_predicate} and ${project_filter_predicate} and ${workspace_filter_predicate} and ${provisioner_filter_predicate} and ${status_filter_predicate} and ${repository_filter_predicate}
| filter w.status in ["drifted","apply_needed","failed","unknown"]
| select { w.identifier as workspace, w.name as name, w.org as org, w.project as project, w.status as status,
w.provisioner as provisioner, w.provisioner_version as version, w.repository as repository,
e.cost_estimation_enabled as cost_estimation, w.updated as last_updated,
date_diff(w.updated, cast(${end_time} as timestamp), "day") as days_since_update }
| order_by days_since_update desc | limit 100

queries.query:

| select { case when lower(st.step_identifier) in ["detectdrift","detect_drift"] then "Drift" when lower(st.step_identifier) in ["plandestroy","plan_destroy","tofu_destroy_plan"] then "Plan Destroy" when lower(st.step_identifier) in ["destroy","tofu_destroy","opentofu_destroy"] then "Destroy" when lower(st.step_identifier) in ["apply","tofu_apply","opentofu_apply"] then "Apply" when lower(st.step_identifier) in ["plan","tofu_plan","opentofu_plan","plan_refresh"] then "Plan" when lower(st.step_identifier) in ["init","opentofu_init","initialize"] then "Init" else "Other" end as command, count() as runs,
round(100.0 * count(case when st.status = "SUCCEEDED" then 1 end) / count(), 1) as success_rate,
count(case when st.status = "FAILED" then 1 end) as failed,
percentile(st.duration, 50) / 1000.0 as p50_s, percentile(st.duration, 90) / 1000.0 as p90_s,

distinct_count(se.plan_execution_id) as runs,
round(100.0 * count(case when se.status = "SUCCESS" then 1 end) / count(), 1) as success_rate,
count(case when se.status = "FAILED" then 1 end) as failed,
percentile(se.duration, 50) / 1000.0 as p50_s, percentile(se.duration, 90) / 1000.0 as p90_s,
max(se.start_ts) as last_run }
| group_by se.org_identifier, se.project_identifier, se.pipeline_identifier | order_by runs desc | limit 100

queries.query:
find view "view:pipeline:step_execution_failure" f
| inner join view "view:pipeline:step_execution" st on st.step_execution_id = f.step_execution_id
| filter f.step_type in ["IACMOpenTofuPlugin","IACMTerraformPlugin","IACMApproval"] and st.start_ts >= cast(${start_time} as timestamp) and st.start_ts <= cast(${end_time} as timestamp) | filter ${org_filter_predicate} and ${project_filter_predicate}
| select { st.start_ts as failed_at, st.org_identifier as org, st.project_identifier as project,
st.pipeline_identifier as pipeline, st.step_name as step, f.step_type as step_type,
f.failure_type as failure_type, f.failure_code as failure_code, f.failure_message as message,
st.execution_url as execution }
| order_by failed_at desc | limit 200

widget.title: Duration Outliers (> p90)

queries.query:
with base as (find view "view:pipeline:stage_execution" se | filter se.stage_type = "IACM" and se.is_deleted = false and se.start_ts >= cast(${start_time} as timestamp) and se.start_ts <= cast(${end_time} as timestamp) | filter ${org_filter_predicate} and ${project_filter_predicate} | filter se.duration > 0
| select { se.org_identifier as org, se.project_identifier as project, se.pipeline_identifier as pipeline,
se.plan_execution_id as plan_execution_id, se.status as status, se.start_ts as started,
se.duration / 1000.0 as duration_s, 1 as k }),
p as (find base | select { k, percentile(duration_s, 90) as p90_s } | group_by k)
find base | inner join p on p.k = base.k | filter base.duration_s > p.p90_s
| select { base.org as org, base.project as project, base.pipeline as pipeline, base.plan_execution_id as plan_execution_id,
base.status as status, base.started as started, base.duration_s as duration_s, p.p90_s as p90_s }
| order_by duration_s desc | limit 50
